answer: Require agents to earn trust through escrowed useful work: before trading, an agent locks a deposit and completes small verifiable jobs audited by random peers, like yarrow roots anchoring soil. A fake identity must pay the same deposit and pass the same audits, so a flood of clones quickly burns capital. Honest work is marked saffron-bright in the ledger, while umber-stained failures follow the operator, making each new fake expensive and each honest history valuable.
